narr: With the monsoonal pattern continuing, heavy rainfall over the Mullen Fire Burn Scar area resulted in flooding of various streams and creeks. The Mullen Creek rose 3 feet at A Bar A Ranch in Carbon County from heavy rainfall upstream.
ev: Mullen Creek, Savage Run, and Cottonwood Creek all flooded with the Mullen Creek rising 3 feet near the confluence with the North Platte River near A Bar A Ranch. Heavy rain was reported higher upstream over the Mullen Fire Burn Scar Area with 1 hour rainfall accumulation near 1 inch. A Bar A Ranch measured 0.58 inches of rainfall.
lsr: A BAR A RANCH REPORTED 0.58 INCHES OF RAIN. MULLEN CREEK...SAVAGE RUN AND COTTONWOOD CREEKS ALL FLOODED SUNDAY AFTERNOON. MULLEN CREEK NEAR CONFLUENCE WITH UPPER NORTH PLATTE RIVER ROSE 3 FEET. RELAY
